entry_criteria: Sterling Grid: HMA slope↑ + RSI>50 + MACD cross-up + UC rising + Price<$25 + Theme + Investment Gate PASS
exit_criteria: ExD compound exit (HMA falling + UC falling) OR tiered profit lock (+200%→15%, +100%→20%, +50%→25%)

themes.name: AI Power Infrastructure & Grid Modernization
themes.thesis_summary: Power availability has become the primary constraint on AI expansion, forcing a strategic pivot from relying on public grids to developing integrated power solutions. This creates a multi-year investment cycle in grid modernization, nuclear power, and energy infrastructure as hyperscalers invest hundreds of billions in dedicated power generation.
key_catalysts: Global data center power demand to grow from 55GW to 84GW by 2028
Trump administration promising to 'open up energy plants' for AI
Microsoft/Oracle each announcing >10GW data center projects
Grid connection backlogs forcing on-site power generation solutions

themes.name: Defense Industrial Base Modernization
themes.thesis_summary: Geopolitical tensions and defense budget increases are driving a multi-year modernization cycle, with supply chain bottlenecks in solid rocket motors, electronics, and manufacturing creating investment opportunities in defense industrial capacity expansion and next-generation production technologies.
key_catalysts: Pentagon FY2026 budget request of $961.6B plus $150B reconciliation
Defense reindustrialization and supply chain reshoring initiatives
Solid rocket motor supply chain investments ($73M+ contracts announced)
3D printing/additive manufacturing scaling for expeditionary production

themes.name: Healthcare Sector Contrarian Recovery
themes.thesis_summary: After 2.5 years of underperformance due to policy uncertainty and COVID impacts, healthcare is positioned for recovery as drug pricing clarity emerges, AI adoption accelerates, and valuations remain attractive relative to expected returns. The sector offers defensive characteristics with AI-driven efficiency upside.
key_catalysts: Policy headwinds around drug pricing and ACA largely cleared
AI adoption in healthcare driving efficiency gains

themes.name: Communication Services AI Monetization
themes.thesis_summary: Communication services companies are successfully monetizing AI investments through improved advertising efficiency and new product offerings, with continued capex driving infrastructure demand. While crowded, fundamental earnings support and AI monetization runway justify continued exposure.
key_catalysts: Q4 2025 earnings beats from Alphabet and Meta driving sector growth
Continued hyperscaler AI capex driving infrastructure demand
AI model monetization accelerating beyond ChatGPT and coding assistants

themes.name: Financial Services AI Adoption & Rate Environment
themes.thesis_summary: Financial services positioned to benefit from AI infrastructure financing demand and potential improvement in rate environment, though near-term momentum weak. AI adoption by banks creating operational efficiency opportunities while deregulation expectations provide additional tailwind.
key_catalysts: AI capex buildout creating demand for banking services
Potential yield curve steepening benefiting bank margins
